summary: cisco.nxos requires ansible-core 2.14+, removes four deprecated modules, and needs ansible.netcommon 6.1.0+ for cli_restore.
questions: Which netcommon version does cisco.nxos require?
Were any nxos modules removed in Ansible 10?

answer_card.title: cisco.nxos changes in Ansible 10
answer_card.answer_md: cisco.nxos requires ansible-core 2.14+ and ansible.netcommon 6.1.0+ (for `cli_restore`), and removes four previously deprecated modules.
